components.name: Glow Button
components.description: Primary action: --c-tinted translucent fill, colored glow, top-edge seam. Used for Registrar, the active segmented-control button, and 'Añadir semana'.
components.css: .ds-btn-glow{--c:#2E8BFF;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.075);backdrop-filter:blur(30px) saturate(118%);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 48%,transparent);border-radius:18px;color:#fff;font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:16px;width:100%;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 26px -2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 45%,transparent),0 0 10px -2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 70%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);transition:transform .12s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1),box-shadow .22s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1);}.ds-btn-glow::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.32),transparent);}.ds-btn-glow:hover{box-shadow:0 0 32px -2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,transparent),0 0 12px -2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 80%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28);}.ds-btn-glow:active{transform:scale(.97);}.ds-btn-glow:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Base card: flat translucent fill, hairline border, 1px top-edge light seam. No gradient layering, no drop shadow — the one universal content surface.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Floating 5-icon pill nav; the active button gets a --halo-tinted gradient fill and glow. The active icon color always matches the current background halo.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabbar"><button class="ds-tab active" style="--halo:#2E8BFF">●</button><button class="ds-tab">●</button><button class="ds-tab">●</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabbar{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);backdrop-filter:blur(34px) saturate(175%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);box-shadow:0 16px 44px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.85);}.ds-tab{border:0;background:transparent;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:999px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.34);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1);}.ds-tab.active{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--halo) 34%,transparent),rgba(255,255,255,.07));box-shadow:0 0 20px -4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--halo) 80%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);}

components.name: Sticky Screen Header
components.description: Every screen's eyebrow title, pinned at env(safe-area-inset-top) with a solid fill, backed by a fixed full-width mask of the same color over the exact status-bar height — the correctness mechanism that keeps every title out from under the iOS clock/battery.

narrative.overview:
As of noviembre 2026 the training model changed completely (three fixed weekly sessions — series de ritmo, rodaje base, velocidad — plus a monthly test replacing velocidad on the first Friday of the month), and the visual system changed with it: this build drops the previous gym-tracker-style skin (Bebas Neue, SF Mono, pill nav with sliding indicator) in favor of estudio-tracker's own language — near-black glass with a top-edge light seam, a single color "halo" radiating from the background that shifts per tab, oversized Archivo Narrow numerals sitting directly on the void rather than inside a card, and a floating pill tab bar. The two apps (1000m and estudio) are meant to read as the same family now; this is the intentional reskin that establishes it, superseding the earlier "ported from gym-tracker" direction entirely.

The material is near-black glass (#030304) everywhere, thinner and less saturated than the previous system (saturate(118%) vs. 180%), with a soft two-point radial halo behind the whole viewport that recolors per tab (blue for Hoy/series, neutral grey for Historial, amber/gold for Progreso, red for Físico, slate for Ajustes). Big numbers — the day's session title, PR tiles, chart deltas, the fisico current-value readouts — use condensed Archivo Narrow directly on the glass or on the bare background; everything administrative (labels, dates, table-like rows) stays small, uppercase, letter-spaced Archivo.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black glass (.glass) with a 1px top-edge light seam on every card, no saturated color fill
A single shifting "halo" background radial-gradient keyed to the active tab/section, not a static accent
Archivo Narrow condensed bold for headline numerals and short display labels; Archivo for everything else
Per-session-type color is fixed and carries through the whole app (series blue, rodaje green, velocidad orange, test amber) — never reused for chrome
Selected/active chip and segmented-control states use the glowing --c-tinted btn-glow treatment, not a flat invert

rules.name: The Halo-Per-Section Rule
rules.body: The background radial-gradient's color (--halo) always matches the active tab's assigned color, set on tab click exactly as in kit-componentes.html. It is the one "mood" signal on screen; no other chrome element recolors independently of it.

rules.name: The Type-Owns-Its-Color Rule
rules.body: Each of the four session types (series/rodaje/velocidad/test) keeps one fixed color everywhere it appears — hero title, CTA, agenda dot, history dot, chart line. A color never migrates to a different type or to generic chrome.

rules.name: The Top-Edge Seam Rule
rules.body: Every .glass card and .btn-glow element carries a 1px ::before gradient seam (transparent → rgba(255,255,255,.3) → transparent) across its very top edge — the one universal signature ported from the kit. Apply it to any new glass-like surface.

dos: Do keep each session type's color fixed everywhere it appears (hero, CTA, dots, charts) — never reassign it to chrome.
Do let the background halo recolor per active tab, per the Halo-Per-Section Rule.
Do use stroke SVG icons exclusively; the app has a hard no-emoji rule end to end, including the agenda toggle and the pitidos info affordance.
Do render small numeric values with font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums on Archivo rather than introducing a mono face.
Do fall back to the two-number/delta treatment for any chart with ≤2 points rather than drawing a misleadingly sparse line.

Do wrap every screen's title in .scr-head and shrink every data-less chart to .empty-mini with a specific, actionable sentence — these are the two standing layout-correctness rules, not one-off fixes.
donts: Don't reintroduce Bebas Neue or an SF-Mono-style data face — this build retired that pairing in favor of Archivo/Archivo Narrow across the board.
Don't add a drop-shadow tier to ordinary .glass cards; depth here comes from translucency + blur + the top-edge seam only, not shadows.
Don't pull in Chart.js or any charting dependency; all graphs are hand-rolled inline SVG, consistent with the kit's own hand-SVG components.
Don't give the tab bar's active state a second accent color independent of --halo — the active tab button's glow must always read as the same color currently driving the page's background halo.
Don't render a generic "Sin datos todavía" placeholder at full card height for a scoped chart — it must name what specifically will fill it, at minimal height.
Don't make "Descanso" the visual protagonist of the Hoy screen — it renders at Display md, not Hero, and is immediately followed by the next real training day.
